description: This file implements a DeviceIdentityStore class that manages device identity information, including creation, storage, signing, verifying signatures, and deriving device IDs based on cryptographic keys. It uses BouncyCastle for cryptographic operations and serializes data with kotlinx.serialization.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A data class representing the device's identity information including device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: A class that manages loading, creating, signing, and verifying device identities, stored in a JSON file within the app's internal storage.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key, returning a Base64 URL-safe signature.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature for a payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key in Base64 URL format.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from file.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads the device identity from a specified file, decoding JSON content.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a given device identity as JSON into the file.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device key pair, computes device ID, and creates a DeviceIdentity object.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives the device ID from the public key's raw bytes using SHA-256.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of data and returns it as a hex string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes given data into a Base64 URL-safe string without padding.
